d:
A heavy-set, bulky android with a weathered, rust-brown metallic exterior and a singular glowing red optic sensor. The build is massive and tank-like with thick, armored plating. It wears remnants of a deep-charcoal cloak that is shredded at the edges. It possesses four thick, heavy metallic claws on each hand and a thick, segmented mechanical tail.
BODY COLOR: rust brown
